The Maharashtra Public Service Commission has declared the Group C Result 2026 on 4th May 2026 at mpsc.gov.in. Candidates who appeared for the Preliminary Exam on 11th January 2026 can now check their results on the official website. The MPSC Group C result PDF lists the roll numbers of candidates who have qualified for the next stage. MPSC has also released the category wise cut off marks for the Mains exam. Read below to know how to check the MPSC Combined Group C result and download the merit list.

MPSC Group C Result 2026 Out

MPSC Group C Result 2026 has been officially declared. Candidates who appeared for the Preliminary Examination can now access their results online. Category wise cut off marks have also been released by MPSC. Candidates shortlisted in the Prelims will appear for the MPSC Group C Bharti Mains Examination.

MPSC Combined Group C Result 2026 Download Link

Maharashtra Public Service Commission has released MPSC Group C Result 2026. The result is available in PDF format and includes the roll numbers of candidates shortlisted in the Preliminary Examination. Candidates can download the result PDF from the official website using the link given below. The PDF confirms eligibility for the MPSC Group C Mains Examination. Keep roll numbers handy while checking the result.

Download Here MPSC Group C Result 2026 – Direct Link

MPSC Group C Result Overview

MPSC Group C Result 2026 is out. Candidates who appeared for the Preliminary Exam can check their results online. Candidates can refer to the details given below for exam and result information.

Particulars Details
Exam Name MPSC Combined Group C Preliminary Exam 2026
Exam Date 11 January 2026
Result Status Released
MPSC Group C Result Date 4th May 2026
Next Stage Mains Examination
Cut-off Marks Category wise cut off released
Official Website mpsc.gov.in

Steps to Download MPSC Group C Result 2026?

Candidates can check MPSC Group C Result from the official website after it has been released. The result shows the roll numbers of candidates selected for the next stage.

  • Visit official website of the Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC)
  • On the homepage, look for the Results or Latest Updates section
  • Click on the link for MPSC Group C Preliminary Result 2026
  • The result PDF will open on the screen
  • Download the PDF and save it for future reference
  • Use Ctrl + F and enter roll number to check qualification status

What After MPSC Group C Result 2026?

After the MPSC Group C Result 2026, shortlisted candidates will move to the next stage. Those who clear the Prelims must appear for the Group C Mains Examination. MPSC will release the Mains exam dates separately. Admit card details will also be announced on the official website. Candidates should keep checking updates to avoid missing any notice.

MPSC Group C Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is the MPSC Group C Result 2026 released?
Ans. Yes. The MPSC Group C Preliminary Result 2026 has been released on 4th May 2026 its official website.

Q2. Where can I check the MPSC Group C Result 2026?
Ans. You can check the result on the official MPSC website at mpsc.gov.in.

Q3. Are cut-off marks released along with the result?
Ans. Yes. Category-wise cut-off marks have been released with the result.

Q4. What is the next stage after the MPSC Group C Prelims?
Ans. Candidates who qualify the Prelims will appear for the MPSC Group C Mains Examination.

Q5. When will the MPSC Group C Mains exam be held?
Ans. The Mains exam schedule will be announced separately by MPSC on the official website.
